title: 心室輔助幫浦流場模擬
summary: 「心室輔助幫浦流場模擬」教學路線圖：裝置架構、感測與致動、台架測試和品質管理；不含臨床操作指示。專案級來源與工序細節待查證。
summaryEn: Learning roadmap for Ventricular Assist Pump Flow Modeling: device architecture, sensing and actuation, bench testing, and quality management; no clinical operating instructions. Project-specific sources and work steps require verification.
